evaluation: M = ceil((2^64 − 1) / 2) = 2^63, so 2M = 2^64 overflows. With any B >= 0xC8 (the ParityMap minimum), M <= 2^64/200 and 2M + 1 cannot overflow; the vector reaches the formula only if the Reader takes B from the header field.
integrity_repair: CRC at 0xC0 of all three blocks
quotes: The minimum block size for ParityMap files is 0xC8.
shadowed: If the Reader first checks the header block_size against the actual block size (a rule the text does not state for ParityMaps) or against the 0xC8 minimum, that check fires; the name is ParityMapParse either way.
